question: A 17-year-old female is brought to the emergency room by her parents shortly after a suicide attempt by aspirin overdose. Which of the following acid/base changes will occur FIRST in this patient?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Aspirin overdose -> increased anion gap -> anion gap metabolic acidosis -> 80% CHAIN: Aspirin overdose -> increased respiratory rate -> respiratory alkalosis -> 70% CHAIN: Aspirin overdose -> increased lactic acid production -> non-anion gap metabolic acidosis -> 80%
enhanced_information: In a 17-year-old female following an aspirin overdose, the first acid/base change to occur is likely respiratory alkalosis due to increased respiratory rate. This is supported by the chain linking aspirin overdose to increased respiratory rate leading to respiratory alkalosis. The evidence path mentioning fatigue as a manifestation of metabolic acidosis is not directly relevant to the immediate acid/base change in this scenario.
analysis: In a 17-year-old female following an aspirin overdose, the first acid/base change to occur is likely respiratory alkalosis due to increased respiratory rate.
